slides: Your body reads consistency louder than intensity.
Every repeat writes a neural script.
That script tells muscles to fire without thought.
Skip the script and you’ll stall at the gym.
Show up daily; the script does the heavy lifting.
Discipline is a compass, not a lock.
It points toward the outcome you value.
When you pause, the compass still points.
You decide whether to follow or ignore it.
Let the compass guide every choice.
Energy is a battery you recharge with motion.
Light activity spikes mitochondria like a spark.
That spark fuels focus, mood, and recovery.
Sedentary habits drain the charge faster than sleep.
Move now, and your battery stays full.
Habits grow best on a friction‑free track.
Remove the extra steps that stall the start.
Stack tiny triggers that flow into each other.
Each trigger reduces the effort to begin.
Design a smooth track; momentum will carry you.
